invariants: Booking creation runs in a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and rolls back on any failure.

A second active booking for the same staff member at the same start time always fails with SlotConflictError (code SLOT_CONFLICT); non-canonical rephrasings of the same instant are rejected earlier by validation.
Bookings against services whose duration is not exactly 30 minutes fail with BookingReferenceError (code BOOKING_REFERENCE_ERROR); variable-duration services are out of scope for the MVP.
Different staff members may hold active bookings at the same start time.
Cancelling an active booking frees the slot for rebooking; cancelling an unknown or already-cancelled booking fails predictably.
Concurrency claim is limited to sequential same-process checks: no genuine simultaneous-race test is claimed.
